title: Brentford's Man Utd Target Story: Patience Beats Panic
body:
A Brentford defender has been reported as a Manchester United target, with the story tied to United's January budget [S1].

That tells you the market is busy, and that other clubs are protecting their own assets before the window even opens.

The form numbers tell the clearer story. Brentford have taken 7 points from their last five league games, with two wins, one draw and two defeats, scoring 8 and conceding 5 [ST1]. United have managed just 2 points from the same span, with no wins, two draws and three defeats, and they have conceded 14 [ST2]. That gap is the real story. One side is winning enough to be picky, while the other is leaking goals and needs fixing more than it needs headlines.

If this one goes through, it says plenty about where the club thinks it is heading. The smart money is on patience, because rushed deals rarely age well, and a side with a settled back line has less reason to panic-buy. Any move should be judged on whether it solves a real problem, not on how good it looks in a newspaper.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
